why_bad: The professional repair removes Spill’s improvised rag patch, hand-slip failure, and partial hold without a real repair.

target: Hard bolt first. Of course. I crouch and put the wrench on the seized head. Nothing. Just resistance. Then the cover clicks against the housing. Better opening. I leave the bolt and pry the cover instead. My thumb catches the sharp edge.
